items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) - StyleSmuggler
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution through a template injection flaw, notably via the 'Payment Transaction Failed Reminder' email. It has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It is a regularly scheduled update and does not include the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVSS 9.1), security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues at the time of publication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to affected Adobe Commerce applications. Exploitation requires no user interaction and can be performed over the network.
